Class BnsLbcViscosityMethod

java.lang.Object
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.PhysicalPropertyMethod
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.commonphasephysicalproperties.CommonPhysicalPropertyMethod
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.commonphasephysicalproperties.viscosity.Viscosity
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.commonphasephysicalproperties.viscosity.LBCViscosityMethod
neqsim.physicalproperties.methods.commonphasephysicalproperties.viscosity.BnsLbcViscosityMethod
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, ViscosityInterface, PhysicalPropertyMethodInterface
public class BnsLbcViscosityMethod extends LBCViscosityMethod
Lohrenz-Bray-Clark viscosity using the Burgoyne-Nielsen-Stanko fitted parameters (SPE-229932-MS and the 2026 helium extension).
